correctness.rationale: Orthogonal coordinates make E_α a rank≤2 block [[0,-H^-1 b],[-α b^T,1-αd]]. The two singular values are those of T_α=[[0,-c],[-αp,1-αd]]. Positive-semidefinite test for zI−T^TT and a concave determinant quadratic give the stated minimax and uniqueness, including b=0 and transition dc=p. The SPD Schur complement of 2I−B^{1/2}AB^{1/2} gives spectral interval. Exact witness H=diag(1,4), b=(1/2,2), d=27/20 has ||E_opt||²=2550/2429>1 although spectral radius<1. Independent check: Independently reconstructed operator T and its spectral norm for 100 random SPD block systems with dimensions m∈{1,2,3,5}; checked each analytic minimum against seven other α values. For the exact 3×3 witness computed α=810/2429 and norm²=2550/2429 independently. Tests supplement PSD determinant proof.
